scope: Readback-only diagnostics for frozen complete public0.3 tasks. No model fitting, temperature calibration, recipe selection, new inference, aggregate Decision Index, or statistical equivalence claim.
reference: Original HF GLiDE BF16, serial batch1
probabilities: Original ordered active-option probabilities at temperature1. Revalidate against the saved active readout logits; do not use the API confidence field, which is a top1-minus-top2 margin for choice.
brier: Unnormalized multiclass Brier: sum over active options of (p_i - 1[i=gold])^2, then arithmetic mean over requests. No division by number of classes.

nll.gold_probability_zero: Unclipped mean NLL is +infinity, represented by null plus an explicit infinity flag and zero-gold-probability count.

ece.confidence: max active-option probability, not GLiDE's API confidence

paired: both correct / BF16-only correct / candidate-only correct / both wrong
per-request active-option probability MAE, total variation, and Jensen-Shannon divergence in nats
centered all255-readout RMS drift and maximum absolute drift
aggregation: Per complete task only. Never combine these five scores into a Decision Index.
prior_exposure: Each complete pool includes prior recipe-selection and final-slice cases; not a wholly fresh held-out test. Original-model training overlap is unknown.
failure_policy: Reject incomplete, duplicate, failed, uncertain, membership-mismatched, identity-mismatched, or hash-mismatched arm snapshots. Keep denominator and status counts explicit. Never fill missing predictions with a score.
